persons.name: Lakṣanārāyaṇa
persons.evidence: likhāpaītvā (!) sakodeśe jalaṣu tola vāgvatuthikṣeyānhulakṣanārāṃyā (!) manasa dharmacitta utpattijuyā

date.as_written: śrīśāke 1796 || śrīvikramādi 1931 śrīnepālī śrayos tu samvat 994 sālam iti naṣṭa āṣāḍhavadi 8 roja 3

notes: The catalogue lists Lakṣyanārāyaṇa as the scribe, but the Newari colophon has likhāpaītvā ('having had it written') and dharmacitta utpattijuyā ('pious mind having arisen'), identifying him as the patron/commissioner. The date is recorded in three eras: Śaka 1796, Vikrama 1931, and Nepāla Saṃvat 994.
